meta.title: About FocusNow: Built by Cihan & Barbaros
meta.description: FocusNow is built by two people, Cihan and Barbaros, to waste fewer hours and leave room for family, hobbies and rest. Read our story.

about.mission: Deep work shouldn't require deep effort.
about.description: FocusNow started with a question we kept asking at the end of busy days: where did all that time go? We read the research on attention, took inspiration from Cal Newport's Deep Work, and built something simple that bends to your rules. Once you know where your day goes, the week and the month fall into place, and there's room again for the work that matters and the life around it.

simplicity.title: Effortless
simplicity.content: No buttons to press to be tracked. FocusNow runs in the background and shows you where your time went. The rules are yours: you decide what counts as focus and what counts as distraction.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.content: No screenshots, no keystrokes. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest and never sold. You can export it or delete your account whenever you like.

transparency.title: Honest
transparency.content: We say what we collect, how we store it and why. We also say what FocusNow doesn't do, on our comparison pages and in the app.

founder.title: A note from the founders
founder.content: FocusNow is built by two people, Cihan and Barbaros. We didn't start it to squeeze more hours out of ourselves. We started it to waste fewer of them: to finish focused work in focused time and keep the rest for family, hobbies and downtime. We wanted to see where our days went without handing that answer to a surveillance tool, so we built our own. We use FocusNow every day, and it grows with what our users tell us. When you write to <mail>info@focusnow.ai</mail>, one of us answers.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: FocusNow ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy covers the FocusNow website and desktop application. It explains exactly what data we collect, how we use and store it, who processes it on our behalf, and the rights you have over your personal information. This version replaces the version dated July 30, 2026.

trustPromise.title: 1. Our Privacy Promise
trustPromise.content: At FocusNow, we believe your productivity data is deeply personal. Before anything else, here is our commitment to you:
items: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data
We never share your activity data with advertisers or data brokers
We never take screenshots of your screen
We never record keystrokes, mouse clicks, or form inputs
We never use your data for advertising or marketing profiling
You can delete your activity history and sessions from within the app at any time — and delete your account entirely, whenever you want, from Settings → Account

dataController.title: 2. Data Controller
dataController.content: FocusNow is developed and operated by Barbaros Zongur, based in Turkey. As the data controller, we decide how and why your personal data is processed. For all privacy-related inquiries, you can reach us at info@focusnow.ai.

collection.title: 3. Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect only the data needed to provide you with productivity insights. Here is exactly what we collect and why:
items: Account information — your email address, display name, and which sign-in provider you used (Google or Microsoft). We never receive or store passwords
Optional profile details — your job title and sector, if you choose to provide them, and your working hours, if you set them. These make your AI daily report more relevant (see section 6)

Activity data — the names and file paths of the applications you use, window titles, the web addresses (URLs) you visit, whether you are active, idle, or away, timestamps and durations, and your focus session details. This powers your productivity analytics

Timecard and billing data — if you use timecards, the projects, clients, tasks, tags, time entries, rates, currencies, notes and work statements you create. Client records can include the contact name, email, phone, address and tax number you enter for that client. This data is synced so it is available across your devices and can be exported

Diagnostics and usage analytics — operating system and app version, device architecture, language and theme settings, usage events, approximate location, and error reports. Collected only if you opt in, apart from two anonymous events that contain no identifier (see section 7)
Website data — what the focusnow.ai website collects is described in the cookies section below

Website form data — if you use the contact form we receive the name, email address, topic and message you submit; if you join the Pro waitlist we store your email address. Both are used solely to reply to you or to notify you about Pro, are never sold or shared, and are deleted on request

tracking.title: 4. How Activity Tracking Works
tracking.content: While it is running, the desktop app checks which window is in the foreground roughly every two seconds — including outside focus sessions. On macOS this requires the Accessibility permission, which you can revoke in System Settings at any time. You stay in control:
items: Your data is recorded on your device first, in a local database, and synced to the cloud while you are signed in
You can exclude specific applications and websites from tracking in Settings
You can delete individual activity logs and sessions from within the app — deletion removes them from both the cloud and your device
Quitting the app stops all tracking immediately

usage.title: 5. How We Use Your Data
usage.content: We use your data exclusively to provide and improve the FocusNow experience:
items: Categorize your activity automatically and build your analytics dashboards
Sync your data so your productivity history follows your account
Generate personalized focus insights and daily reports
Send service-related communications (updates, security alerts)
Diagnose technical issues and improve app performance (opt-in analytics only)
usage.note: We do not use your activity data for advertising, marketing profiling, or any purpose unrelated to the FocusNow service.

aiInsights.title: 6. AI-Generated Insights
aiInsights.content: When you request a daily report, that day's activity records — application names, window titles, URLs, timestamps, and categories — are processed by Azure OpenAI Service running inside our own Microsoft Azure subscription in the European Union. If you have provided them, your job title, sector and working hours are included as well, so the report can interpret your day in the context of your actual work rather than in the abstract. Your name and email address are never sent. Your data is not used to train AI models. The generated report is stored in your account so it does not have to be regenerated.
aiInsights.note: AI-generated insights are informational only and can be inaccurate. They are not professional, medical, or employment advice.

analytics.title: 7. Analytics and Diagnostics
analytics.content: The desktop app asks for your consent on first launch before sending any analytics or diagnostics that can be linked to you. Whichever way you answer, the app sends two anonymous events — that it was launched, and what you answered — carrying only the app version, operating system and system language. These let us count how many people install FocusNow and which versions and systems to support. They contain no identifier of any kind, no location, and no link to your account or to each other, nothing is stored on your device to enable them, and they cannot be traced back to you. We send them on the basis of our legitimate interest in maintaining the app. Everything below is sent only if you consent:
items: Error and diagnostic reports are sent to Azure Application Insights so we can find and fix bugs

Product usage events (for example, which features are used) are sent to PostHog, hosted in the European Union. Before you sign in they are recorded under a random identifier stored only on your device; afterwards, under the random account identifier our servers generate for you — never your name or email
Your approximate location (country and region), derived from the IP address your device connects from, so we know which countries to support
Session replay captures how the FocusNow app's own interface is used, with all text inputs masked. It never records your screen, other applications, or their content
Your job title and sector are never included in analytics data — they are used only to shape your AI daily report (see section 6)
analytics.note: You can change your choice at any time in Settings → Privacy. Turning analytics off immediately stops everything listed above, including location; only the two anonymous events described at the top continue.

storage.title: 8. Data Storage and Infrastructure
storage.content: Your synced data is stored in Microsoft Azure (Cosmos DB) in European Union data centers:
items: Encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and encrypted at rest using AES-256
Azure compliance certifications: SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001, GDPR-ready infrastructure
Physical and logical access controls at all data centers
A local copy of your data is kept on your device for offline access; the local database file name does not contain your email address in readable form

internationalTransfers.title: 9. International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.content: FocusNow is operated from Turkey, and your data is processed in Microsoft Azure data centers located in the European Union. Where data is transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA) or Turkey, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and equivalent safeguards recognized by applicable data protection authorities. Our processors handle data under data processing agreements that include these safeguards.

security.title: 10. Data Security
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
items: TLS 1.2+ encryption for all data in transit; AES-256 encryption at rest in the cloud
Sign-in is handled entirely by Google and Microsoft — we never see or store passwords
Sign-in tokens are stored encrypted on your device
Every API request is authenticated, and your data is isolated per account
security.note: No system is 100% secure. We take reasonable and appropriate measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

sharing.title: 11. Data Sharing and Third Parties
sharing.content: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. Data is shared only with the service providers below, and only to operate FocusNow:
items: Microsoft Azure — hosts our backend, database, and AI processing in EU data centers under a Data Processing Agreement
PostHog (EU-hosted) — receives opt-in, pseudonymized product analytics and session replay (see section 7)
Google and Microsoft — handle sign-in to your account; your login is processed under their own privacy policies. With your consent, Google Analytics also runs on our website
GitHub — distributes app downloads and automatic updates; when the app checks for updates, GitHub receives standard technical data such as your IP address
Legal requirements — when required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request
Business transfers — in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your data may be transferred as part of that transaction, with advance notice to you

cookies.title: 12. Cookies and Website Analytics
items: Essential cookies — required for basic site functionality
Google Analytics — runs only if you accept it via the cookie banner (analytics are off by default) and shows us aggregate information such as pages visited, traffic sources, and countries
No advertising cookies, ad trackers, or social media pixels
cookies.note: You can decline or withdraw cookie consent at any time. Desktop app analytics are separate and controlled in the app's settings (see section 7).

retention.title: 13. Data Retention
retention.content: We keep your data only as long as necessary:
items: Activity logs, focus sessions, and AI daily insight reports are retained in the cloud for up to 12 months on a rolling basis, then automatically deleted; your account and profile information are kept for as long as your account stays active
Timecards, projects, clients, and work statements have no automatic expiry in the cloud, because they are your billing records; they stay until you delete them or delete your account
On your device, data is not deleted by age: the local database keeps your history until you delete it in the app or uninstall FocusNow, even after the matching cloud records have expired
When you delete data in the app, it is removed from both the cloud and your device
Account deletion requests are completed within 30 days; certain data may be retained longer where required by applicable law

A record of your consent choices (what you agreed to or declined, when, and where) is kept after account deletion, so we can show how consent was given if it is ever questioned; it contains no activity data
Aggregated, anonymous statistics that cannot identify you may be retained for service improvement

rights.title: 14. Your Rights (GDPR & KVKK)
rights.content: Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), and similar laws, you have the right to:
items: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
Rectification — request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
Erasure — request deletion of your account and all associated data
Data portability — request an export of your data in a machine-readable format
Restriction — request that we limit processing of your data
Objection — object to processing based on legitimate interest
Withdrawal of consent — withdraw consent for optional processing (such as analytics) at any time in the app or on the website
Complaint — lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in Turkey, the Personal Data Protection Authority; in the EEA, your national authority)
rights.note: You can export your data and delete your account directly in the app (Settings → Account). For everything else, email info@focusnow.ai — we respond within 30 days.

children.title: 15. Children's Privacy
children.content: FocusNow is not intended for use by children under the age of 13 (or the applicable minimum age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child without parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.

changes.title: 16. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. When we make material changes, we will notify you through the app or via email before the changes take effect. Your continued use of FocusNow after the changes become effective constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 17. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights:
items: Email: info@focusnow.ai
Response time: within 30 days of receiving your request
contact.note: Data Controller: FocusNow — Barbaros Zongur, Turkey. This policy is provided in English and Turkish; if the two versions conflict, the English version prevails.

freelancers.title: Bill from what you did, not from memory.
freelancers.description: FocusNow records your day on its own. At the end of the week you pick what belongs to each client, and the hours and amounts add up for you.
freelancers.heroAlt: Projects page: a client project with logged and billable hours, amount, budget used and recent entries
freelancers.day: Mornings on the Brightline redesign, a call with Northwind after lunch, email in between. On Friday you open Calendar, select the records that belong to each client and add them to a timecard. Coverage shows how much of the tracked week made it onto a timecard, and Ready to bill lists each client with hours and amount.

freelancers.compareText: Weighing FocusNow against a timer-first tool?

items.question: Can FocusNow prepare what I send to clients?
items.answer: Yes, as a work statement: billable entries for a client, exported as PDF or CSV. It isn't a tax invoice. Create the invoice in your accounting tool and add its number to the statement as a reference.

items.question: Do I have to run timers when I switch projects?
items.answer: No. FocusNow records your activity automatically. Later you pick the records that belong to a project and add them to a timecard. The timer is there if you prefer it.

items.question: Will clients see my activity?
items.answer: No. Your records stay in your account. A client sees only what you put on a work statement.

items.question: Are timecards free?
items.answer: Timecards, billing and reports are free during early access. We plan to include them in a paid Pro plan later and will share the terms before anything changes. Core tracking stays free.

items.question: Does FocusNow read my code or log keystrokes?
items.answer: No. It records app names, window titles and, in browsers, the site's domain. It never records keystrokes, the clipboard or screen content.

items.question: Does it work with IDEs, terminals and browsers?
items.answer: Yes. Any desktop app counts, including VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, terminals and browsers, so context switches become visible.

items.question: Can I track time per ticket?
items.answer: Yes. Create a task for the ticket and start sessions from it. Its actual time combines those sessions with any records you link to it.

items.question: Will it slow down my machine?
items.answer: It checks the window in front about every two seconds and otherwise stays out of the way in the background.

items.answer: You set the rules. Mark your notes and course sites as Focus and a video site as Distraction, and your day sorts itself.

items.answer: No. Tracking runs on its own. Pomodoro and Deep Work sessions are there when you want structure.

items.answer: Yes. Core tracking and focus sessions are free for everyone, with no card and no separate student plan.

items.question: Is FocusNow free?
items.answer: Core tracking, focus sessions and Productivity are free, with no card. Timecards, billing and reports are free during early access. We plan to move them into a paid Pro plan later and will announce the terms before that happens.

items.question: Which computers does it run on?
items.answer: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later on Apple Silicon or Intel, from our download page, and Windows 10 or later (64-bit) from the Microsoft Store. There is no Linux or mobile app.

items.question: What does FocusNow record?
items.answer: The app in front of you, its window title, the site's domain in your browser, and whether you're active, idle or away. It never takes screenshots or logs keystrokes.

items.question: Does it assign my time to clients automatically?
items.answer: No. You choose which tracked records go on a timecard and which project they belong to. FocusNow keeps the record and does the arithmetic.

items.question: Is a work statement an invoice?
items.answer: No. It summarizes your work for a client and exports as PDF or CSV. FocusNow doesn't issue tax invoices or collect payments. You can add your own invoice number to a statement.

items.question: Does it work offline, and can I take my data with me?
items.answer: Tracking keeps going offline and syncs when you're signed in and back online. Settings → Account exports all of your data, and you can delete your account at any time.

meta.description: Six time trackers sorted by need: personal focus, client hours, teams, local-only data and platform. Written by FocusNow, with our bias stated up front.

alternatives.title: How to choose a time tracker
alternatives.intro: Most time trackers handle the basics well. The right one depends on what you need the numbers for. Start with the questions below, then read short notes on six tools.
alternatives.disclosure: We make FocusNow, so read this with that in mind. We've described each tool as fairly as we can, checked the details against official pages on September 26, 2026, and said where another tool is the better choice. Nobody paid to be listed.

criteria.title: Is it for your focus or your invoices?
criteria.body: Focus tools show patterns and sessions. Client tools turn time into entries, rates and statements. Some do both.

criteria.title: Timer or automatic record?
criteria.body: Timers are precise when you remember them. Automatic tracking catches everything and asks you to sort it later.

criteria.title: Just you, or a team?
criteria.body: Team plans add shared projects, roles and reports. Tools for one person stay simpler.

criteria.title: Where should the data live?
criteria.body: Some tools keep everything on your device. Others sync to the cloud so you can reach it elsewhere.

criteria.title: Which devices?
criteria.body: Check macOS, Windows, Linux and mobile support before you commit.

focusnow.fit: Solo professionals who want automatic tracking, focus sessions and timecards in one desktop app.
focusnow.consider: No distraction blocking, no mobile or Linux app, no team features. You assign time to clients yourself.
focusnow.price: Core tracking free; timecards and billing free during early access.

rize.fit: People who want AI to assign sessions to projects, plus blocking, integrations and team dashboards.

rescuetime.fit: People who want focus sessions with blocking, goals and alerts, and mobile apps. Timesheets for client work come with Solo+.
rescuetime.price: From $7 a month billed annually; Solo+ $12.

toggl.fit: Timer lovers and teams who need projects, billable rates, invoicing and reports on web, desktop and mobile.
toggl.consider: The timer is the main habit. The automatic Timeline is a helper in the desktop apps.
toggl.price: Free plan; paid from $9 per user a month billed annually.

timely.fit: Agencies and consultancies that want AI-drafted timesheets built from an automatic record.
timely.consider: Priced per user, with a 14-day trial.
timely.price: From $9 per user a month billed annually.

activitywatch.fit: Privacy-minded users who want free, open-source tracking with data kept on their own device, including on Linux.
activitywatch.consider: No focus timer or client billing, and syncing between devices is still in progress.

alternatives.closing: Whichever you pick, try it for one full week of real work before you decide.
